name: @bongtu/client
description: bongtu client engine — the React-free, wagmi-free protocol layer both apps drive: key derivation + the in-memory KeyCache lock, login/session/key-binding, witness assembly (spend/deposit), the prove+submit flow orchestrations, viem submits over a `Connection`, indexer reads and refresh policy, and the kKRW money edge. App config (pool, token, explorer, prover) is threaded in through each flow's ctx/deps seam — this package reads no env and imports no app config.
